completion_promises.criterion_text: Loading a four-folder corpus produces CorpusChunks with correct source_type per folder (covers @key-example @ingestion scenario "loader infers source type")
completion_promises.evidence: load_corpus walks the four canonical folders and assigns SourceType per parent directory via SOURCE_TYPE_FOLDERS mapping. Verified by test_loader_infers_source_type_from_each_of_four_folders which asserts all four SourceType values appear and that file→folder routing matches expected text_name.

completion_promises.criterion_text: AQA past-paper-named file is refused; refusal log line references publisher prohibition (covers @negative @ingestion @copyright scenario)
completion_promises.evidence: AQA_REFUSAL_PATTERN regex applied to filename in _process_file before any read. Refusal recorded with reason=AQA_ASSESSMENT_MATERIAL and detail string containing 'AQA' and 'publisher prohibition'. Verified by test_aqa_named_file_is_refused_with_publisher_log and the parametrised test_aqa_pattern_catches_assessment_material_filenames covering past_paper.pdf, Mark-Scheme.pdf, examiner_report_2024.pdf, PastPaper.txt, mark_scheme.txt, examiner-report.pdf.

completion_promises.criterion_text: In-copyright modern set text in primary_text/ is refused; log advises per-student Phase 2 path (covers @negative @ingestion @copyright scenario)
completion_promises.evidence: INCOPYRIGHT_TITLES frozenset matched case-insensitively against normalised filename stem (hyphens/spaces/dots → underscores). Refusal detail mentions 'per-student Phase 2 path'. Verified by test_incopyright_match_is_case_insensitive_with_punctuation parametrised over inspector_calls.txt and Inspector-Calls.txt, and test_incopyright_titles_constant_lists_required_entries asserting all six required titles are present.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Empty primary_text/ folder produces zero chunks and no error (covers @boundary @ingestion scenario)
completion_promises.evidence: load_corpus on an empty corpus skeleton returns IngestResult with chunks_created=0 and chunks=[], no exception raised. Verified by test_empty_primary_text_folder_produces_zero_chunks_no_error.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Whitespace-only file is skipped with structured log (covers @boundary @ingestion scenario)
completion_promises.evidence: After read_text, _process_file checks `not text.strip()` and emits SkipRecord(reason=WHITESPACE_ONLY) plus a logger.warning('corpus.skip.whitespace_only') with structured extras. Verified by test_whitespace_only_file_is_skipped.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Corrupted file in primary_text/ is skipped; valid file in same folder still loads (covers @edge-case @ingestion @resilience scenario)
completion_promises.evidence: read_text wrapped in try/except for UnicodeDecodeError and OSError; on failure a SkipRecord(reason=CORRUPTED_FILE) is appended and processing continues with sibling files. Verified by test_corrupted_file_is_skipped_and_valid_neighbour_still_loads which writes invalid UTF-8 bytes alongside a valid Macbeth fixture and asserts both the skip is recorded AND the valid neighbour still produces chunks.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Path-traversal file is rejected; refusal log names the attempt (covers @edge-case @ingestion @security scenario)
completion_promises.evidence: _process_file resolves each candidate with strict=True and calls relative_to(root); ValueError → RefusalRecord(reason=PATH_TRAVERSAL) whose path field names the offending file. Verified by test_symlink_escaping_corpus_root_is_refused which creates a symlink in primary_text/ pointing outside the corpus root.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Plays produce chunks with PlayCitationAnchor (act/scene/line); novels produce chunks with NovelCitationAnchor (chapter/paragraph) (covers @edge-case @verify @integration @citation scenario)
completion_promises.evidence: _infer_citation_anchor dispatches on presence of ACT vs CHAPTER markers and runs a state-machine walker (_infer_play_anchor / _infer_novel_anchor) that tracks act/scene/line or chapter/paragraph and captures the first content line/paragraph at-or-past the chunk's char_offset. Verified by test_play_chunks_carry_play_citation_anchor (Macbeth fixture → PlayCitationAnchor with act=1/scene=1) and test_novel_chunks_carry_novel_citation_anchor (Christmas Carol fixture → NovelCitationAnchor with chapter=1). The seam test test_corpus_chunk_carries_typed_citation_anchor independently re-validates the discriminated-union contract with TASK-PRV-001.

completion_promises.criterion_text: No chunk carries an unset/default source-type label (covers @key-example @ingestion scenario)
completion_promises.evidence: source_type on CorpusChunk is non-defaulted (no = default in corpus_models.py), and the loader only ever instantiates it from SOURCE_TYPE_FOLDERS lookup — Pydantic ValidationError would fire if it were ever omitted. Verified by test_no_chunk_carries_default_or_unset_source_type which asserts every chunk's source_type is a SourceType enum member with a value in the canonical set.

completion_promises.criterion_text: All modified files pass project-configured lint/format checks with zero errors
completion_promises.evidence: Files use `from __future__ import annotations`, modern PEP 604 union syntax, type hints on all public functions, docstrings on module + every public symbol, no bare except, specific exception catches (UnicodeDecodeError, OSError), pathlib.Path throughout, logging module (no print). The repo has no enforced linter command in pyproject.toml beyond pytest; pytest collection passes cleanly with no warnings.
